pr.body: Interpolating queries as the initial step. Fixes #107530
pr.title: Query splitting: Interpolate queries at the start of the process

raw_findings.body: applyTemplateVariables now runs at the start of runSplitQuery, but each split sub-request is later executed via runQuery -> super.query() (DataSourceWithBackend), which applies applyTemplateVariables/addAdHocFilters again. Template variables and ad hoc filters are interpolated twice, so ad hoc label matchers can be appended twice, producing duplicated/incorrect selectors sent to the backend.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Doubly-interpolated query with duplicated ad hoc filters is sent to the backend.
raw_findings.impact: applyTemplateVariables now runs at the start of runSplitQuery, but each split sub-request is later executed via runQuery -> super.query() (DataSourceWithBackend), which applies applyTemplateVariables/addAdHocFilters again. Template variables and ad hoc filters are interpolated twice, so ad hoc label matchers can be appended twice, producing duplicated/incorrect selectors sent to the backend.
raw_findings.root_cause: Interpolation was moved to the start of runSplitQuery without removing the pre-existing interpolation performed by DataSourceWithBackend during runQuery/super.query.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Interpolate the queries in exactly one place: either keep interpolation at the split entry point and prevent the downstream DataSourceWithBackend interpolation from re-applying, or leave interpolation to the backend layer and only compute the value locally where needed (e.g. sharding selector).
raw_findings.title: Queries interpolated twice before reaching backend
raw_findings.trigger: A Loki query is run through the query-splitting path (feature toggle lokiQuerySplitting) while ad hoc filters (request.filters) are present.

raw_findings.body: runShardSplitQuery now interpolates via applyTemplateVariables, but it later delegates execution to runSplitQuery (line 163), which was also changed to call applyTemplateVariables, and that in turn executes via super.query() which interpolates again. The new test itself asserts applyTemplateVariables is called 5 times, confirming repeated interpolation; ad hoc filters can be appended on each pass, yielding duplicated selectors.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Query is interpolated multiple times, risking duplicated ad hoc filters in the executed shard sub-requests.
raw_findings.impact: runShardSplitQuery now interpolates via applyTemplateVariables, but it later delegates execution to runSplitQuery (line 163), which was also changed to call applyTemplateVariables, and that in turn executes via super.query() which interpolates again. The new test itself asserts applyTemplateVariables is called 5 times, confirming repeated interpolation; ad hoc filters can be appended on each pass, yielding duplicated selectors.
raw_findings.root_cause: Both runShardSplitQuery and the delegated runSplitQuery apply applyTemplateVariables, stacking on top of the DataSourceWithBackend interpolation.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Interpolate the targets only once for the shard path; do not re-run applyTemplateVariables inside the delegated runSplitQuery when the targets are already interpolated (e.g. pass a flag or interpolate solely at one layer).
raw_findings.title: Shard split path re-interpolates queries an extra time
raw_findings.trigger: A query executed through runShardSplitQuery (feature toggle lokiShardSplitting) with ad hoc filters present.

raw_findings.body: The removed interpolateVariablesInQueries added `datasource: this.getRef()` to every query; applyTemplateVariables only spreads the target and does not set datasource. Downstream consumers that rely on target.datasource being populated will now see it absent for shard-split queries.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Interpolated shard queries lack the datasource reference that the previous code provided.
raw_findings.impact: The removed interpolateVariablesInQueries added `datasource: this.getRef()` to every query; applyTemplateVariables only spreads the target and does not set datasource. Downstream consumers that rely on target.datasource being populated will now see it absent for shard-split queries.
raw_findings.root_cause: applyTemplateVariables does not replicate the datasource-ref assignment that interpolateVariablesInQueries performed.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: If downstream code depends on query.datasource, set it explicitly in the map callback (e.g. `{ ...datasource.applyTemplateVariables(...), datasource: datasource.getRef() }`).
raw_findings.title: Shard interpolation drops datasource reference previously set on queries
raw_findings.trigger: Any query run through runShardSplitQuery after this change.

finding.title: Queries interpolated twice before reaching backend
finding.trigger: A Loki query is run through the query-splitting path (feature toggle lokiQuerySplitting) while ad hoc filters (request.filters) are present.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim that DataSourceWithBackend.query() re-applies applyTemplateVariables is not supported by the evidence. Looking at datasource.ts:350-357, runQuery() calls super.query() which is DataSourceWithBackend.query(), but there's no evidence this method calls applyTemplateVariables again. The applyTemplateVariables method is documented as 'Called from DatasourceWithBackend' but this means it's available to be called, not that it's automatically invoked. The patch moves interpolation to runSplitQuery entry point, and runQuery just transforms the backend result.

finding.title: Shard split path re-interpolates queries an extra time
finding.trigger: A query executed through runShardSplitQuery (feature toggle lokiShardSplitting) with ad hoc filters present.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim relies on runShardSplitQuery calling runSplitQuery which then re-interpolates. However, examining shardQuerySplitting.ts:163, runSplitQuery is called with subRequest which has targets from interpolateShardingSelector(targets, shardsToQuery) - these targets come from adjustTargetsFromResponseState, not the original request.targets. The test asserting 5 calls to applyTemplateVariables is not shown in the patch context, and the claim about DataSourceWithBackend interpolating again lacks evidence. The interpolation paths are separate.

finding.title: Shard interpolation drops datasource reference previously set on queries
finding.trigger: Any query run through runShardSplitQuery after this change.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim that interpolateVariablesInQueries added datasource: this.getRef() is correct per datasource.ts:436-438, but the patch in shardQuerySplitting.ts shows the OLD code called interpolateVariablesInQueries (L49-50 removed), while NEW code calls applyTemplateVariables. However, there's no evidence that downstream code actually depends on query.datasource being set. The queries are passed to splitQueriesByStreamShard which uses them internally. Without concrete evidence of a consumer requiring this property, the impact is speculative.
